facts.fact: On 15 July 2026 the Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Civil Aviation presented to the Prime Minister its action plan for the period July-December 2026, which sets a target of raising national 2G and 4G coverage to 85% with 34 new towers in Annobon and the interior, and the Prime Minister told it to keep to the timetable; the document calls it a ministry action plan, not a national broadband plan.
